title: Instagram AI内容检测系统再次失控：用户遭遇错误标注
summary: Instagram的AI内容标签功能旨在帮助用户快速识别AI生成的图片，但近期该系统出现严重故障。大量用户报告称，Meta自动将“AI内容”标签应用于非AI生成的图片，包括普通照片、数字艺术甚至历史图片。这一错误标注引发了用户对平台审核机制和AI检测准确性的广泛质疑。目前Meta尚未给出明确解释，但专家指出，AI检测技术仍存在局限性，尤其是在区分真实摄影与AI生成内容时，容易受到图像压缩、滤镜和后期处理等因素干扰。此次事件不仅影响了用户体验，也暴露了社交媒体平台在AI内容治理上的短板，可能促使Meta优化其检测算法并改进标签策略。
summary_en: Instagram's AI content labeling feature, designed to help users quickly identify AI-generated images, has malfunctioned again. Numerous users report that Meta has automatically applied 'AI Content' labels to non-AI images, including ordinary photos, digital art, and even historical pictures. This mislabeling has sparked widespread criticism of the platform's moderation mechanisms and AI detection accuracy. Meta has not yet provided a clear explanation, but experts suggest that AI detection technology still has limitations, especially in distinguishing real photography from AI-generated content, as it is easily affected by factors like image compression, filters, and post-processing. This incident not only harms user experience but also exposes shortcomings in social media platforms' AI content governance, potentially prompting Meta to refine its detection algorithms and labeling strategies.
